steps.code:
# Parse all notes: extract date from title and habit values from content
import re
from datetime import datetime

parsed_notes = []
for note in notes_data:
    title = note['title']
    m = re.search(r'Habit Tracking Log for (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', title)
    if not m:
        print(f"Warning: could not parse date from title: {title}")
        continue
    date_str = m.group(1)
    content = note['content']
    # Parse lines like "habit: yes/no"
    habits = {}
    for line in content.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line:
            habit, value = line.split(':', 1)
            habit = habit.strip()
            value = value.strip().lower()
            if value in ('yes', 'no'):
                habits[habit] = value
    parsed_notes.append({'date': date_str, 'habits': habits})

print(f"Parsed {len(parsed_notes)} notes")
print("First parsed:", parsed_notes[0])
print("Last parsed:", parsed_notes[-1])
